raw: 41.1 CIA Tradecraft Primer: SATs for Intelligence Analysis[^189][^108]
teaching_note: Structured analytic techniques externalize parts of reasoning so assumptions, alternatives, and disagreements can be examined; their existence in doctrine does not establish universal debiasing or accuracy gains. Select an assumptions check for fragile premises, ACH for competing explanations, and alternative futures for scenario exploration rather than forcing every question into one matrix. The CIA and CDSE versions are access routes to the same primer, not independent studies of effectiveness [@ageint189; @ageint108].
title: CIA Tradecraft Primer: SATs for Intelligence Analysis

raw: 41.2 ICD 203 Analytic Standards: The Nine Tradecraft Standards[^2][^190]
teaching_note: Map the nine standards to inspectable product fields: source quality/credibility to a source note; uncertainty to likelihood and separate confidence; information versus assumptions/judgments to labeled statements; alternatives to a competing-account paragraph; customer relevance to the decision question; logical argument to the evidence-to-inference chain; change/consistency to a revision history; accuracy to resolved-claim review; and effective visuals, where appropriate, to a legible evidence-linked display. These are product standards, not nine proven psychological treatments or an additive probability score. The objectivity pages provide context; the directive is the standard-setting source [@official_odni_icd_203].
title: ICD 203 Analytic Standards: The Nine Tradecraft Standards

teaching_note: Heuer's account emphasizes that perception and interpretation are shaped by mental models, so the same report can be read differently under different assumptions. Distinguish the original text from a biography and a later commentary; three citations do not mean three replications of a psychological effect. Use the account to make reasoning contestable, not to diagnose a reviewer with a bias whenever they disagree [@ageint192; @ageint191; @ageint180].
title: Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (Heuer, CIA 1999)

teaching_note: A technique is a sequence of operations with a purpose and failure modes, not merely a named worksheet. State the question, source dependencies, assumptions, and what would change the answer before selecting a method; preserve an unresolved result when available evidence cannot discriminate. Treat professional handbooks as procedural support, not evidence that every technique improves every task [@ageint193; @ageint194; @sec:analytic-workflow].
title: Structured Analytic Techniques (Heuer & Pherson, 2011)

teaching_note: **Completed synthetic ACH.** Explain a fictional gallery closure notice with H1 planned closure, H2 publication error, H3 mixed/unknown cause. At 08:00 E1 is a screenshot saying closed, at 08:05 E1b copies it, and at 08:10 E2 is a signed schedule saying open: using C = compatible, I = inconsistent, ? = insufficiently specified, rows E1 = (C,C,?), E2 = (I,C,?); E1b is grouped with E1, not counted anew. H2 is provisionally less contradicted, but H3 is not excluded; removing E2 leaves no discrimination, so confidence is low and release of a causal attribution is held. At 08:20 a supplied card shows E2 was superseded: withdraw H2's advantage and record unresolved alternatives. ACH cells are ordinal consistency judgments, never probabilities to sum; compatibility alone is not equal likelihood. Separately, stipulated P(E|H1)=0.8 and P(E|H2)=0.2 give LR=4 and, with prior odds 1:1, posterior odds 4:1 only under that two-hypothesis Bayesian toy model; real likelihoods, priors, reliability, dependence, and omitted explanations require justification [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer; @scholarly_karvetski_mandel_2020_ach_coherence].
title: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH)

teaching_note: Devil's advocacy tests a favored conclusion; a red team can examine a wider set of framing and process failures. In the gallery case, the challenger asks whether the schedule is current and whether a benign publication error fits the screenshot, rather than inventing evidence of hostile intent. Keep advocacy separate from the final assessment, record the strongest rebuttal and unresolved dissent, and prohibit live adversarial activity; the inherited AI/software-security citations are context, not validation of this analytic method [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer].
title: Devil's Advocacy and Red Teaming

teaching_note: Alternative futures produces plausible scenarios and signposts, not posterior probabilities or a single predicted future. For a fictional gallery next month, cross uncertain staffing continuity with repair completion to create four scenarios; an approved roster and a completion certificate are discriminating signposts, while repeated rumors are not independent indicators. Examine scenarios that break the selected axes and keep an unknown pathway open; standards/index citations do not establish the method's efficacy [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer; @scholarly_mccarthy_2024_alternative_futures_analysis].
title: Alternative Futures Analysis

teaching_note: Separate generation from evaluation: first list possible explanations without pretending they are evidence, then group duplicates and test plausibility against supplied facts. For the gallery notice, include a date mismatch, partial closure, transcription error, and genuinely changed plans before considering deception. An exhaustive hypothesis set cannot be guaranteed, and a longer list or unanimous group is not automatically better calibrated [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer].
title: Brainstorming and Divergent Thinking Techniques

teaching_note: A deception hypothesis asks whether evidence could have been selected or altered, but must compete with mistake, outdated information, and genuine disagreement. Inconsistency is a reason to examine provenance, not proof of deliberate deception; apparent motive and opportunity do not establish that an act occurred. Use only supplied documents, with no interpersonal truth tests, physiological inference, covert contact, or forced attribution [@ageint193].
title: Deception Hypotheses: Competing Accounts and Attribution Limits

teaching_note: An assumption is a premise used without establishing it in the present packet. For the gallery judgment, list 'schedule is current', 'notice covers the whole site', and 'copies are independent'; mark the last false and the first two unresolved, then state which conclusion depends on each. The superseded-schedule card defeats the first premise and forces revision, rather than being absorbed as a minor footnote [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer].
title: Key Assumptions Check

teaching_note: Define an indicator by an observable event, expected timing, source, competing explanations, and opportunity to observe. A fictional closure certificate issued before opening time is a stronger indicator of planned closure than website silence; silence is meaningful only if the site was operating and routinely published that information. Record false alarms, missing coverage, and dependency among indicators; STIX/TAXII transport standards do not validate an indicator's predictive value [@official_cia_tradecraft_primer].
title: Indicators Validator

teaching_note: A what-if explores consequences of a stipulated condition; a premortem stipulates failure and generates possible causes before a plan is executed. Suppose the fictional gallery's brief was wrong tomorrow: candidate causes are a stale schedule, lost qualifier, and copied report counted twice; map each to a current check and a reversible hold. These are candidate failure paths, not observed causes or measured failure probabilities [@professional_klein_2007_project_premortem; @official_cia_tradecraft_primer].
title: What If? / Pre-Mortem Analysis

raw: 41.5 Analytic Tradecraft and the Intelligence Community (Tandfonline, 2014)[^195]
teaching_note: Tradecraft standards make reasoning and sourcing inspectable, but institutional adoption and publication visibility are not outcome validation. Distinguish process compliance, agreement among reviewers, and accuracy on resolvable questions; they may diverge. Without a task-matched comparator and defensible scoring rule, a polished structured product cannot establish that a technique caused better analysis [@ageint195].
title: Analytic Tradecraft and the Intelligence Community: Professional Context

raw: 41.6 Analytic Tradecraft Standards in Army Intelligence[^196]
teaching_note: Applying standards in an organization requires observable review criteria, not simply declaring a product objective. In the gallery case, two fictional reviewers can both find good sourcing yet disagree on confidence because one wrongly treats the superseded schedule as current; adjudication should identify that premise rather than average their labels. Professional discussion illustrates implementation issues, not universal rater reliability or accuracy [@ageint196].
title: Analytic Tradecraft Standards in Army Intelligence

raw: 41.7 Cognitive Biases: Confirmation Bias, Anchoring, Groupthink in Intelligence[^180]
teaching_note: Confirmation bias concerns preferential treatment of congenial evidence; anchoring concerns undue influence of an initial reference; groupthink concerns group processes that inhibit challenge. They are distinct explanatory possibilities, not labels to assign from disagreement alone. A useful negative control removes the first report or gives a reviewer the same packet in a different order; a changed classroom answer reveals sensitivity in that fixture, not a clinical or universal bias diagnosis [@ageint180; @ageint192].
title: Cognitive Biases: Confirmation Bias, Anchoring, Groupthink in Intelligence

raw: 41.8 From Spycraft to Self-Mastery: SATs for Everyday Decision-Making[^188]
teaching_note: Transfer the reasoning operation, not an intelligence-service authority claim: in an offline travel-planning example, a stale timetable and two copied summaries require version checking before choosing a route. A justified 'insufficient information' answer can be better than a complete matrix with invented likelihoods. Successful performance on a second synthetic task is evidence of that task result only, not proof of durable everyday debiasing or immunity to manipulation [@ageint188].
title: SATs for Everyday Decision-Making: Bounded Transfer
